text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Brother Thomas.

text: 你看到托马斯兄弟。
source_text: 你看到托马斯兄弟。

text: Okay children. Today we will be going over some martial arts.
source_text: Okay children. Today we will be going over some martial arts.

text: 好的孩子。今天我们将学习一些搏斗技巧。
source_text: 好的孩子。今天我们将学习一些搏斗技巧。

text: In close combat the technique you use depends on your# opponents size, reach, and quickness.

In close combat the technique you use depends on your

source_text: 在近战中使用什么技巧取决于你对手的大小，距离和速度。

text: 如果给你试探对手的机会。

text: Don't rush the attack.
source_text: Don't rush the attack.

text: 不要急于进攻。
source_text: 不要急于进攻。

text: All right my little one, try to hurt poor old gramps.
source_text: All right my little one, try to hurt poor old gramps.

text: 来吧小伙子们，和我这个老头子较量较量。
source_text: 来吧小伙子们，和我这个老头子较量较量。

text: Ah!

source_text: Uhh.

source_text: 噢。

text: Well that's all for now, so let's review.

text: 人都到齐了，我们开始复习。
source_text: 人都到齐了，我们开始复习。

text: You see how he lost his balance?
source_text: You see how he lost his balance?

text: 你们看到他刚才怎么失去平衡了吧？
source_text: 你们看到他刚才怎么失去平衡了吧？

text: Overextending yourself leaves you open for a counter attack.
source_text: Overextending yourself leaves you open for a counter attack.

text: 动作太大反而使你受到攻击。
source_text: 动作太大反而使你受到攻击。

text: When you attack be sure not to overextend.
source_text: When you attack be sure not to overextend.

text: 当你进攻时最好不要动作幅度太大。
source_text: 当你进攻时最好不要动作幅度太大。

text: Why is overextending so bad?
source_text: Why is overextending so bad?

text: 为什么动作幅度太大不好？
source_text: 为什么动作幅度太大不好？

text: If you have the opportunity for a kill, shouldn't you go for it?
source_text: If you have the opportunity for a kill, shouldn't you go for it?

text: 如果你有一个机会杀死对方，你会不去做吗？
source_text: 如果你有一个机会杀死对方，你会不去做吗？

text: That's a lot to risk your life over.
source_text: That's a lot to risk your life over.

text: 那是一个致命的危险。
source_text: 那是一个致命的危险。

text: Overextending leaves your inside vulnerable to a counter attack# and puts you off balance.

Overextending leaves your inside vulnerable to a counter attack

text: 动作幅度太大的话，你的弱点就被暴露，对方也会轻易的把你打倒。
source_text: 动作幅度太大的话，你的弱点就被暴露，对方也会轻易的把你打倒。

text: One little shove will land you right on your ass.
source_text: One little shove will land you right on your ass.

text: 轻轻一推你就会屁股落地。
source_text: 轻轻一推你就会屁股落地。

text: Okay, let's give another young punk a try at gramps.
source_text: Okay, let's give another young punk a try at gramps.

text: 好，让我们给另外一个壮汉与老头子较量的机会。
source_text: 好，让我们给另外一个壮汉与老头子较量的机会。

text: Let's see if you've learned from the previous example.
source_text: Let's see if you've learned from the previous example.

text: 让我们看看你以前学过的是什么？
source_text: 让我们看看你以前学过的是什么？

text: Not bad, that last move almost got me.
source_text: Not bad, that last move almost got me.

text: 不错，你快要打到我了。
source_text: 不错，你快要打到我了。

text: Are you sure you want to be a Scribe Initiate?
source_text: Are you sure you want to be a Scribe Initiate?

text: 你真的打算做一个初级研究员？
source_text: 你真的打算做一个初级研究员？

text: Those talents would be a shame to waste.
source_text: Those talents would be a shame to waste.

text: 天赋被浪费是个耻辱。

text: We'll just keep you in reserve. Okay?

text: I'm just fooling with ya.

text: 我只是开个玩笑。

text: You may want to reconsider a career as a Knight.

text: Just think about it.
source_text: Just think about it.

text: 考虑考虑。

text: 谢谢你托马斯兄弟。

I hope you all noticed how Brother Anthony did not overextend

source_text: 他还知道怎么利用我的身材庞大和体重来进攻。

text: Very good. You lasted much longer than I thought you would.

text: You can go back to the line.

text: Well, I hope you kids were able to catch what was going on.
